# Accepted npm advisories — HIGH/CRITICAL findings we have reviewed and chosen
# not to fail on. Both the CI "Security audit" job and the local Claude Code
# dependency hook read this file (via scripts/check-advisories.sh) and exclude
# the GHSA ids listed below. One bare GHSA id per line; everything after `#`
# is a justification. Remove an entry the moment a real fix is available.
#
# GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx — deepmerge-ts <8.0.0 stack exhaustion (high).
#   Reached only via prisma -> @prisma/config -> deepmerge-ts. `prisma` is a
#   devDependency (the CLI); it never ships to the Vercel runtime. Its only
#   caller merges our own trusted prisma config at build/CLI time — no
#   attacker-controlled input — so real exposure is nil. Upstream confirms it
#   "does not actually affect Prisma CLI." No forward fix exists yet (every
#   released prisma pulls deepmerge-ts <8; only a downgrade clears it).
#   Revisit when Prisma ships @prisma/config on deepmerge-ts >=8.
